dedupe_keys.name: a dataset for reservoir catchment characteristics for 3254 chinese reservoirs i e res cn

description: The University of Tokyo, DTU Space and Wuhan University publish Res-CN, a collection of catchment attributes and remotely observed states for 3,254 Chinese reservoirs. Its 512 attributes cover topography, human activity, climate, land cover, soils and geology. Full upstream catchments and intermediate catchments are supplied separately. The archive also contains fifteen meteorological variables and estimates of storage anomaly, water level, evaporation and water area. Zenodo provides CSV, Shapefile and ZIP resources under CC-BY-4.0 with open, free access. Availability differs markedly by variable: the repository reports water levels for only 20% of reservoirs, compared with storage anomalies for 92%. Exact time spans must be checked in the component documentation. These inputs could support comparative reservoir modelling or calibrate responses to climate and catchment conditions. They complement the locations in data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs with detailed catchment context and state series. They do not directly establish reservoir release policies or observed operating decisions.
